Boston Celtics — injuries
Pritchard (eye) is questionable for Friday against Charlotte, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
Pritchard is day-to-day after leaving Wednesday's win over the Bucks early. Meanwhile, Jayson Tatum (rest) has been cleared to return. Guys like Baylor Scheierman and Mike Conley could see more run if Pritchard is unable to give it a go.
